name: Hand In The Crusher
source:
A prisoner and her guard escalate a game of dangerous intimacy, within a beach-side home that is not all that it seems. What lies in wait?

[From [url=https://metalflesh.itch.io/hand-in-the-crusher]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一栋暗藏玄机的海滨住宅里，一名囚犯与看守她的狱卒步步升级着一场危险而亲密的博弈。前方究竟潜伏着什么？

[摘自[url=https://metalflesh.itch.io/hand-in-the-crusher]Itch.io[/url]]
